meta.title: BiDLY — brands compete for your traffic
meta.description: Post your traffic once and get offers from affiliate programs in Telegram: Fixed, RevShare, CPA, Hybrid.

hero.lede: Running a channel, a website, a stream, or a media-buying team with traffic to place? Submit one application to BIDLY instead of messaging every affiliate program separately. We'll line up offers from vetted brands: Fixed, RevShare, CPA, or Hybrid.

value.lede: Affiliate programs compete for your traffic instead of the other way around. Fill in the form, add your GEO and stats — offers start landing in Telegram, no back-and-forth with a dozen managers.
value.benefit1_text: The form takes under 3 minutes — no calls, no endless back and forth.
value.benefit2_text: One application goes out to every matching brand at once — you compare, you don't hunt.
value.benefit3_text: Brands know the offer is competitive, so they lead with a stronger rate.

how.subtitle: Four steps between the application and your first deposit from that traffic.
how.step1_text: GEO, platforms, stats, and the partners you've already worked with — in one pass.
how.step2_text: The "Get offers" button links your application to the BIDLY bot — nothing else to fill in.
how.step3_text: Affiliate programs see your application and send terms for your GEO: rate, APK, promo code, manager.
how.step4_text: Open the offer in the bot, tap "Get this offer" — your contact goes straight to the brand.

apply.subtitle: The more precise the data, the more precise the offers. Stats fields are only shown to the brands we match you with.
apply.group1_sub: What you're promoting and where your audience lives.
apply.field_platforms_hint: one per line: channels, sites, streams
apply.group2_sub: Real numbers get you a higher rate — brands can see the offer is justified.
apply.upload_text: or choose manually — channel analytics, campaign stats, tracker dashboard (PNG, JPG, PDF)
apply.group3_sub: This helps brands see who you've worked with already, so they don't repeat offers you've already tried.
apply.group4_sub: Mark what works for you — brands will see the preferred model right away.
apply.field_rate_placeholder: E.g. from $35 per FTD or from 45% RS
apply.field_comment_placeholder: Any details: placement format, timing, special conditions
apply.submit_note: Once submitted, your application enters the system — connect Telegram to get offers automatically.
apply.status_success: Application saved. Telegram will open now — link your account, and the first offers should arrive within a day.
apply.status_error: Couldn't submit the application. Check the fields and try again.
apply.status_error_required: Fill in traffic type and GEO — those are the only required fields.

preview.lede: As soon as a brand responds to your application, the bot sends a card with the terms. Below is what that notification looks like: the partner name, GEO, and rate change every time, but the format stays the same.
preview.point1: One notification template for any partner — only the GEO, rate, and tags change
preview.point2: The "Get this offer" button shares your application and Telegram contact with the brand
preview.point3: Until you tap the button, no contact is shared with anyone
preview.phone_offer_header: 🔔 A new offer is available for your traffic
preview.placeholder_note: Fields in curly braces are filled in per offer — the card looks the same for every partner.

footcta.title: Post your traffic and let brands compete for it
footcta.text: The application takes 3 minutes. After that, a Telegram bot brings offers to you instead of you chasing them.
